title: Scan configuration
statement: Given a Boolean input list $x$, a state $q$, an integer $i$ with $0\le i\le |x|$, and an output list $o$, the associated configuration has state $q$, input-head position $i+1$ in the shifted indexing of the input, no work tapes, and output $o$.
